exposure: dual-strain probiotics (Bifidobacterium infantis and Lactobacillus acidophilus)
cohort: Newborns with ductal-dependent congenital heart disease (CHD) were studied before and after the implementation of oral dual-strain probiotics.
finding: Infants with aortic arch malformations among those with ductal-dependent CHD showed a significant reduction in necrotizing enterocolitis frequency when receiving dual-strain probiotics.
